name: finance-system-root
description: Root workspace for Finance System microservices and frontend

scripts.build: npm --prefix finance-frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('finance-frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend/auth-service && npm install --prefix backend/invoice-service && npm install --prefix backend/request-service && npm install --prefix backend/company-service && npm install --prefix backend/setting-service && npm install --prefix backend/hotel-reservation-service && npm install --prefix backend/api-gateway && npm install --prefix finance-frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm install && npm install --prefix backend/auth-service && npm install --prefix backend/invoice-service && npm install --prefix backend/request-service && npm install --prefix backend/company-service && npm install --prefix backend/setting-service && npm install --prefix backend/hotel-reservation-service && npm install --prefix backend/api-gateway
scripts.backend: concurrently -n "auth,invoice,request,company,setting,hotel,gateway" -c "blue,green,magenta,cyan,red,pink,yellow" "npm --prefix backend/auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/invoice-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/request-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/company-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/setting-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/hotel-reservation-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/api-gateway run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "auth,invoice,request,company,setting,hotel,gateway" -c "blue,green,magenta,cyan,red,pink,yellow" "npm --prefix backend/auth-service start" "npm --prefix backend/invoice-service start" "npm --prefix backend/request-service start" "npm --prefix backend/company-service start" "npm --prefix backend/setting-service start" "npm --prefix backend/hotel-reservation-service start" "npm --prefix backend/api-gateway start"
